title: becium capitatum
intro: Becium capitatum, commonly known as African blue basil or African blue chamomile, is a plant species native to East Africa. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including relief from anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Becium capitatum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its calming and soothing properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
